posts.content_md:
Hi,

Could someone advise my on coating bars please?

I will be coating dcg on to glass and read in practical holography I need around a 7um emulsion layer for DCG. The bar mentioned in the book states a #24 gauge bar but when I looked this up I think this was about 60um.

I have found a UK source for the bars but am not sure if the micron stated for the bar is for the wet film. If it is then I'm guessing there will be some shrinkage once the film dries? 

Can anyone advise how much the the dcg layer will shrink, I know there are a tonne of variables so just looking for a beginners ball park figure please?

If you can advise on a bar to buy based on the layer thickness it puts down then that would also be excellent 

Many Thanks

Grayham
